name: harness-sdk
description: Build an agent harness and control it end-to-end. Open-source SDK for production AI agents in Python & TypeScript - any model, any cloud.
one_liner: A code toolkit for programmers to build their own custom AI agents in a few lines of code, instead of wiring up a model API from scratch.
buyer: A software consultancy that builds custom AI automations for clients and wants a maintained, production-grade SDK (with an official CLI and MCP server) instead of hand-rolling agent plumbing per project.
business_use_cases: A dev consultancy uses it as their standard toolkit to deliver custom internal AI agents to clients faster, billing for the customization rather than the plumbing.
A startup builds a customer-support agent on it and swaps the underlying model provider without rewriting the app, since it's model-agnostic.
An enterprise IT team stands up an internal MCP server with it to expose company data safely to any agent.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'build your first production agent' consulting packages for companies new to agent development.
Build and sell a vertical agent template (e.g. an insurance-claims triage agent) on top of the SDK.

steal_this: It's a developer SDK, not an end product — nothing here is sellable by itself this weekend beyond a demo agent used to pitch consulting work.
